fusions.name: Dropped Weave
fusions.desc: Casts a spreading weave in a cone 5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Drawstring Strike
fusions.desc: A strike from range that deals 8 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and uses up one of your afflictions on the target. It needs an affliction on the target.

fusions.name: Dragnet Sweep
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangled Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
